## This repository accepts issues only

**Pull requests are closed without review.** Please open an issue instead —
the [issue templates](.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/) cover bugs, feature requests,
and questions:

- Bug: <https://github.com/tpt-solutions/tpt-pwa/issues/new?template=bug_report.md>
- Feature request: <https://github.com/tpt-solutions/tpt-pwa/issues/new?template=feature_request.md>

Forking to build your own thing is exactly what the dual license
(MIT OR Apache-2.0) is for — no submission needed. See
[CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for the policy and the design principles
behind it, and [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) for vulnerabilities (never an
issue or PR).
